name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-extensions-react-command-generate-documents
title: react-command-generate-documents
shortDescription: Generate Word and PDF documents from SharePoint templates using a list command and an Azure Function.
longDescription: A SharePoint Framework ListView Command Set that calls an Azure Function to populate a Word template with text, images, checkboxes and tables. The function saves generated Word or PDF documents to SharePoint using the caller's permissions.
